text:
Maya: Hey team — kicking off co-marketing with NimbusCloud for their marketplace integration + joint webinar. Agenda: launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar alignment, inbound lead routing, and asset handoff. Need final dates/owners by EOD Wed. :rocket:

Sam: Love it. Webinar audience = platform engineers + ML infra. Keep it 25–30 min with 15 min demo and 10 min Q&A. Can we lock PM panelists? @Jorge

Jorge: I can take the demo. Will focus on latency/throughput numbers and how Redwood routing + fallback works. Need Nimbus to approve benchmark data usage — @Li can you follow up with legal/data team?

Li: On it. Quick ask: if we quote partner numbers, we need their sign-off and raw CSV. I'll ping their legal today and loop you. Also recommend a short “methodology” sub-section in the blog.

Priya: For the launch post, we should lead with the benchmark story, then CTA to webinar and marketplace listing. Draft headline options this week. Who owns writing? Tom or me?

Tom: I can draft the blog and the webinar abstract. Priya, can you own review and social copy? I'll push a first draft by Tuesday.

Nora: Routing note — we should set marketplace inbound leads to tag source=marketplace and campaign=nimbus-launch, then route to AE queue B. Proposed SFDC mapping:
```
utm_source=marketplace&utm_campaign=nimbus-launch&utm_medium=referral
lead_owner_queue=AE-B
lead_score=25
```
Make sure tracking exists in the marketplace partner portal.

Jorge: Also want a quick landing page with embedded benchmark charts and 1-click demo signup. Design needs assets. @Priya @Tom please add asset checklist.

Priya: Asset checklist: hero screenshot, 2 benchmark charts (latency & cost), 30s demo gif, speaker bios, partner logo pack, CTA buttons.

Tom: Adding UTM params + example routing rule to the shared repo: https://internal.redwood/marketing/nimbus-launch

Maya: Great. Owners summary: Blog/abstract = Tom; Social + review = Priya; Demo = Jorge; Legal sign-off = Li; Lead routing = Nora; Design assets = Priya/Tom. Next sync Thurs 09:00 PT. @deploy-bot can you create the calendar and send invites?

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: Thu Apr 10 09:00 PT — 'Nimbus marketplace + integration co-marketing sync'. Invitees: Maya, Sam, Li, Jorge, Priya, Tom, Nora.

Sam: Small ask — can we add a mini benchmark explainer slide deck (3 slides) for partner sales? I'll draft slide bullets this afternoon.

Maya: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers on approvals or assets, flag here. Thanks all :pray:
